nonClaims: The pack stays unwired from production replay: no production code parses a campaign payload with it. Production sees this change only through the value campaignSchemaPipelineFingerprint() returns, which markers store only when isCampaignJournalAuthorityEnabled() is true (false in production).

The genesis row journals through InMemoryEventJournal, not the SQLite journal the PUT route uses; the co-op and outcome rows use a temp SQLite journal store with no record-rewrite binder. No HTTP route was driven (PUT /api/campaigns/[id], POST /api/multiplayer/matches).

The co-op row seeds the host directly with the co-op builder's state; in production that state reaches the host only through POST /api/multiplayer/matches, whose body schema refuses units carrying sourceVersion (finding F1), so this row proves the pack, not that production can deliver such a snapshot today.
No production writer of a sourceVersion of 0, a negative, a fraction, a string or null was found on the traced paths; that none exists elsewhere is not proven.
Whether a SalvageAllocated.recoveredUnit reaching CampaignMatchHostIntent.ts:204-216 can carry sourceVersion was not measured; its variant is covered by fixtures only.
No build, no Playwright, no npm install; jest one invocation at a time.
Stored cutover markers written before this change (e2e-armed and development databases) were not inspected.

findingsReportedNotFixed.summary: CreateMultiplayerMatchBodySchema (src/lib/api/securitySchemas.ts:83-91 CampaignRosterUnitSchema, .strict(), no sourceVersion; nested at :113, :127, :151) refuses the co-op builder's state when its roster units carry sourceVersion: measured on the baseline with buildCampaignAuthoritativeState output, two unrecognized_keys issues (keys ["sourceVersion"]) at coopCampaign.state.rosterUnits.unit-0 and unit-1; the same state without sourceVersion gives no coopCampaign issue. The route parses its body with this schema (src/pages/api/multiplayer/matches/index.ts:284, read not run). INFERENCE: POST /api/multiplayer/matches refuses co-op registration for a campaign whose roster units carry sourceVersion, which every unit the creation page adds does (CreateCampaignPage.submit.ts:163) since 20f66e145 (#1321).
